mapping_notes: Approximate control correspondence, not a full 1:1 mapping or a manufacturer preset.
roomSize uses the same normalized input as TVerb Size 40 m; downstream geometry differs.
stereoWidth uses the same normalized input as TVerb Width 160 degrees; width semantics differ.
modRate approximately matches TVerb first-stage left LFO 0.19 Hz, not both stages/channels.
modDepth uses the same normalized input; depth and interpolation formulas may differ.
position 0.5 has no direct TVerb equivalent. TVerb Attack 7 percent and Mid Ratio 1 have no independent controls here.
TVerb Normal uses 44100 Hz internally; reconstruction uses host 48000 Hz regardless of qualityMode.
Echo Intensity/Feedback are zero. Both engines still process delay/modulation stages.
